title: Empower Vulnerable Communities
subtitle: 100% of your public donations go directly to community healthcare, WASH infrastructure, and maternal wellness across Nigeria.

impact_tiers.title: Clean Water for a Child
impact_tiers.impact: Provides water testing, sanitation supplies, and hygiene kit for one student for an entire academic year.

impact_tiers.title: Maternal Care Pack
impact_tiers.impact: Funds sanitized birth delivery kits and prenatal screenings for expectant mothers at community outreach clinics.

impact_tiers.title: Mobile Clinic Outreach
impact_tiers.impact: Subsidizes essential pharmaceuticals, malaria diagnostics, and cold-chain vaccines for an entire remote village.

impact_tiers.title: School Sanitation Station
impact_tiers.impact: Co-sponsors a multi-tap touchless handwashing hub with sustainable greywater drainage at a public school.
